rights.mapProvenance: Preface: maps prepared under supervision of Mr. Wsevolod Aglaimoff; cover maps from Army Map Service. Interior maps visibly signed J. R. Crowley.
rights.basis: Official U.S. Department of Army/CMH map authorship is evidence for U.S. Government work status under 17 U.S.C. 105. This is not an explicit Creative Commons license.
rights.caveat: Photographic source appendix includes third-party Stars and Stripes cartoon material; do not apply a blanket license to every image. No photograph needed for front extraction.

commonCartography.latitudeGraticule: 38 degrees north parallel drawn and labeled
commonCartography.reason: A scale bar and one latitude parallel do not uniquely define WGS84 transform. Need independently grounded, unambiguous geographically distributed GCPs and held-out residuals; preserve source uncertainty.
commonCartography.gcpCaveat: Named localities are candidates, not acquired coordinate pairs. Road convergence or text placement is not automatically a precisely located settlement center.

maps.title: Enemy Offensive, January 1951
maps.legendObserved: U.N. front line, date indicated; arrows are axis of enemy attack; dashed line is phase line of U.N. withdrawal
maps.sourceNature: Retrospective official Army operational front depiction; not a cadastral occupied-territory survey
maps.caveat: Avoid all axis arrows and withdrawal phase lines C and D. The earliest observed front label is 31 Dec 1950, not 1 Jan 1951.

maps.title: United Nations Offensive, 25 January–28 February 1951
maps.sourceNature: Retrospective official Army operational front depiction; not a cadastral occupied-territory survey
maps.caveat: Observed labels 24 Jan and 28 Feb; title begins 25 Jan, so do not relabel initial line as 25 Jan.

maps.title: United Nations Offensive, 1 March–21 April 1951
maps.legendObserved: U.N. front line, date indicated; dashed phase lines
maps.sourceNature: Retrospective official Army operational front depiction; not a cadastral occupied-territory survey
maps.caveat: Observed dated fronts distinguish from dashed KANSAS, UTAH, WYOMING, IDAHO phase lines. Title begins 1 Mar but initial front is 28 Feb.

maps.title: Enemy Offensive, 22 April–19 May 1951
maps.legendObserved: U.N. front line date indicated; ground lost 22–29 April and 16–19 May
maps.sourceNature: Retrospective official Army operational front depiction; not a cadastral occupied-territory survey
maps.caveat: 19 May line explicitly labeled APPROX FRONT LINE. Do not claim surveyed exact occupied boundary or confuse hatching/attack areas with the line.

maps.title: United Nations Offensive, 20 May–24 June 1951
maps.legendObserved: U.N. front line date indicated; phase line
maps.sourceNature: Retrospective official Army operational front depiction; not a cadastral occupied-territory survey
maps.caveat: Dashed WYOMING, KANSAS, TOPEKA are phase lines, not actual occupied front; observed initial 19 May differs from period title 20 May.

maps.title: United Nations Front, 25 June–12 November 1951
maps.legendObserved: Dashed U.N. front line 24 June; solid U.N. front line 12 November
maps.sourceNature: Retrospective official Army operational front depiction; not a cadastral occupied-territory survey
maps.caveat: This map dashed 24 June IS actual front according to its local legend; do not apply another map dashed-phase-line rule globally.

maps.title: The Last Battle, 1 January–27 July 1953
maps.legendObserved: U.N. front line 1 January: tick/dot; U.N. front line 27 July: ticked continuous
maps.sourceNature: Retrospective official Army operational front depiction; not a cadastral occupied-territory survey
maps.caveat: Printed note: THE ARMISTICE MILITARY DEMARCATION LINE APPROXIMATES U.N. MLR OF 27 JULY. July line is an observed U.N. front/main line of resistance, not a surveyed MDL. Preserve visible west-coast gaps and separate segments; never close into an occupation polygon or bridge unobserved gaps.
